title: AccountSignon
description: A signon event recorded when a user authenticates with a valid Workday account. Contains details about the authentication including timestamps, IP address, device information, and the outcome of the signon attempt.

id.description: Unique identifier for the signon event

systemAccount.description: The Workday system account username used for the signon

ipAddress.description: IP address from which the signon attempt originated

authenticationType.description: Authentication method used such as SAML, password, or certificate

browserType.description: Browser type used for the signon

operatingSystem.description: Operating system of the device used for the signon

deviceType.description: Type of device used for the signon

deviceIsTrusted.description: Whether the device is registered as a trusted device

isDeviceManaged.description: Whether the device is managed by the organization

sessionId.description: Session identifier assigned to the signon

successful.description: Whether the signon attempt was successful

failedSignonReason.description: Reason for the signon failure if the attempt was unsuccessful

passwordChanged.description: Whether the password was changed during this signon

forgottenPasswordResetRequest.description: Whether a forgotten password reset was requested

multiFactorType.description: Multi-factor authentication type used if applicable

samlIdentityProvider.description: SAML identity provider used if the signon was via SSO

uiClientType.description: Workday UI client type used for the signon

requestOriginator.description: Originator of the signon request such as user-initiated or system-initiated
